guard: a Claude seat's agent commands name why no mod serves them, map every mod answer to its state, bound a start a panel holds, start only on an idle seat, and end the turn a remote interrupt stopped
why: D1 to D12 break the dispatcher and its queue in src/commands.ts, which the suite runs from source.
D13 to D15 break the hooks' turn ends that the queue and a remote interrupt rely on.
D16 to D18 break the lane in connector-core, which the suite loads from its build, so each builds connector-core first and again after the restore.

mutations.name: D1 the list drops Claude's argument hint
mutations.expectRed: the list carries each entry as a command, with its description and its hint as inputHint
mutations.cell: the list carries each entry as a command, with its description and its hint as inputHint

mutations.name: D2 an unknown command is refused as a precondition
mutations.expectRed: an unknown command reads refused, not-found
mutations.cell: an unknown command reads refused, not-found

mutations.name: D3 a policy refusal reads as not-found
mutations.expectRed: a run the mod's policy refuses reads refused, failed-precondition, with its reason
mutations.cell: a run the mod's policy refuses reads refused, failed-precondition, with its reason

mutations.name: D4 a run has no start bound
mutations.find: await within(served().request({ op: "run", command: name, args }), bounds.runMs, late)
mutations.replace: await served().request({ op: "run", command: name, args })
mutations.expectRed: a run a panel holds past the start bound reads unknown, naming the bound and the panel
mutations.cell: a run a panel holds past the start bound reads unknown, naming the bound and the panel

mutations.name: D5 an interrupt leaves the stopped turn open
mutations.expectRed: an interrupt the mod made answers interrupted and ends the seat's turn
mutations.cell: an interrupt the mod made answers interrupted and ends the seat's turn

mutations.name: D6 an idle interrupt ends a turn
mutations.expectRed: with no turn running it answers idle and ends nothing
mutations.cell: with no turn running it answers idle and ends nothing

mutations.name: D7 the dispatcher never names a cause
mutations.expectRed: with no reader, commands answers supported: false
mutations.cell: with no reader, commands answers supported: false

mutations.name: D8 a run skips the check that a mod serves the session
mutations.expectRed: a command queued while the mod served and taken after it left reads refused, failed-precondition, naming the cause
mutations.cell: a command queued while the mod served and taken after it left reads refused, failed-precondition, naming the cause

mutations.name: D9 an interrupt has no bound
mutations.expectRed: an interrupt with no answer within its bound is internal, outcome unknown
mutations.cell: an interrupt with no answer within its bound is internal, outcome unknown

mutations.name: D10 the queue takes a command while the seat runs a turn
mutations.expectRed: a seat running a turn takes no command
mutations.cell: a seat running a turn takes no command

mutations.name: D11 the queue takes a command while a dialog waits
mutations.expectRed: a seat waiting on a dialog takes no command
mutations.cell: a seat waiting on a dialog takes no command

mutations.name: D12 the queue does not wait for a started command's turn to show
mutations.expectRed: the next command waits while the one before it starts its turn
mutations.cell: the next command waits while the one before it starts its turn

mutations.name: D13 a turn's Stop does not tell the queue
mutations.expectRed: a turn's Stop tells the queue
mutations.cell: a turn's Stop tells the queue

mutations.name: D14 a remote interrupt's end does not tell the queue
mutations.expectRed: a remote interrupt ends the hooks' open turn: the seat reads idle and the queue is told
mutations.cell: a remote interrupt ends the hooks' open turn: the seat reads idle and the queue is told

mutations.name: D15 a remote interrupt ends whatever turn is open
mutations.expectRed: an interrupt's end leaves a turn that opened after it working
mutations.cell: an interrupt's end leaves a turn that opened after it working

mutations.name: D16 the lane lists a harness that names a cause
mutations.find: if (!dispatcher || dispatcher.unsupported?.() !== undefined) return { supported: false };
mutations.expectRed: with no reader, commands answers supported: false
